pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
[male vocal]
"Touch You"
“Shh…the song hasn’t started yet.
But I’m already your star.”
[Verse 1]
[female vocal]
Walking alone through the dark streets at night
Your name is written with every step I take
The cold wind cuts right through my bones
And every time, I think of you until I lose my breath
[Pre-Chorus]
[male vocal]
Your warmth came quietly into my heart
Melting away the winter frozen inside me
I can still feel the touch of your fingertips
[Chorus]
Your smile has become everything to me
Even when we're miles apart
It becomes a light that reaches a corner of my heart
Let your light shine down on me
I'm going back to life
[Piano Solo]
[distorted electric piano solo, melodic and sustained notes]
[Verse 2]
Through the window soaked with rain
I spent those days staring at the cloudy sky
Just the sound of your voice could make the world stand still
Like flowers blooming even in the middle of a storm
[Pre-Chorus]
New skin grows over my deepest scars
Just hearing you call my name
Makes me stand back up again
[Chorus]
Your smile has become my strength
No matter how far you are, I can still reach you
Let your light shine down on me
I'm going back to life
[Chorus]
Sometimes the nights without you feel so long
I stand beneath a sky without a single star
And every time, I remember what you said
“I'll be your star”
Those words are what keep me holding on
[Bridge]
Now I'm running to you
Into the darkness where you once stood
I'll take your hand, I'll be your light
And we'll both come back to life
[Final Chorus]
Your smile has become my eternity
It will never change, no matter how the years go by
I'll run all the way to where you are
Just as your light once shone on me
I'll reach out and touch you too
We'll come back to life again
[Outro]
The road I once walked alone in the dark
Now I'm walking hand in hand with you
The quiet space is filled with the sound of your breathing
I'm going back to life
Touch You
Touch You
Touch You
pkg.sunoStyle:
Trendy pop with a soft, energetic groove. Modern, fresh and emotional.
Male-female duet vocals throughout. Alternating lines, natural vocal interplay, gentle harmonies, clear and expressive vocals. Keep both voices distinct and balanced.
Light and simple intro with soft harmony. Verses begin gently with light rhythm, subtle percussion and restrained bass. Pre-chorus gradually builds emotional tension through delicate textures and rhythmic movement, without sudden intensity.
Chorus adds warmth and energy with warm bass, gentle harmonies and a smooth rhythmic lift. Emotional and engaging, but controlled and never explosive.
Final section gradually reduces energy, returning to soft duet vocals and minimal accompaniment, ending calm and reflective.
Natural dynamics, warm tone, clean modern production. Avoid loud mastering, heavy bass, excessive drums, dense layers and aggressive instrumentation.
